name: Isitwalangcengce
body:
ISITWALNGCENGCE
CR 3

This creature resembles a corrupted, twisted hyena with a woven basket for a head.

XP 800
CE Large aberration
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, –1 size)
hp 37 (5d8+15)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +3; +4 vs. fear

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +6 (2d6+6 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks swallow whole (1d6 bludgeoning damage, AC 11, 15 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 16, Con 16, Int 7, Wis 8, Cha 7
Base Atk +3; CMB +8 (+12 to grab); CMD 20
Feats Improved Natural Attack (bite), Lightning Reflexes, Run
Skills Acrobatics +7, Intimidate +1, Perception +9, Stealth +10, Survival +1; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth
Languages Abyssal, Common

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Basket Bash (Ex)

When an isitiwalangcengce has a creature grappled or swallowed, as a standard action it can bash its basket head against a hard surface. The target takes 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 15 Fortitude half), and on a failed save the creature is also stunned for 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

The isitwalangcengce is a hideous predator, capturing prey for later consumption by scooping them up in its basketlike head. It is an opportunistic predator, often attacking people who are butchering meat to steal both the meat and the unlucky person. It particularly loves to eat brains.

Although a dangerous predator and capable of speech, the isitwalangcengce is reputed to be dull-witted and easily tricked. Its strange appearance suggests a weird combination of living creature and construct, perhaps explaining its particular appetite.

Its peculiar head resembles a basket, even with an opening on top. Once it captures prey, it will often abscond with it, planning to bash its victim on a rock later to expose choice brains. However, clever or agile victims may be able to escape this fate. For instance, some victims have allegedly escaped by grabbing overhead branches. Based on its appearance, some speculate it may be the result of a curse, a magical monstrosity, or perhaps of fiendish origin.

Although happy to consume stolen cattle meat or entire children or animals, for some reason, the isitwalangcengce craves the brains of intelligent humanoids. It usually attacks by surprise but consumes prey at leisure.
